editorial.blurb: Two Fish Crab Shack serves up seafood boils and fried specialties in a vibrant, trendy spot that shines when the kitchen and service are on their game.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (ideally Dave) about the gumbo and fried lobster tail—these standout dishes get consistent praise. Go early to avoid long waits and ensure hot food arrives at your table.
